title: Alternative solution for enclosed mezzanines
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: An existing unsprinklered Group F2 industrial building of about 1,880 m² has an enclosed second level about 39% of the lower-storey area. One proposed suite would host a dance/music studio and childcare classified A2 with occupant load over 40; the other would remain F2.

The alternative proposed treating each enclosed second level as a mezzanine, limiting mezzanine area to 40% of suite area, adding smoke detectors using NFPA 72 guidance and monitoring a required fire-alarm system.
The relevant acceptable solutions are Sentences 3.2.1.1.(3) and (4); the record notes the enclosed and partitioned second levels do not meet those prescriptive conditions.
